access_links.label: MLIT dataset metadata and download links

description: MLIT maps logistics hubs across Japan using source material from transport and agriculture authorities, customs, local governments and operators. The July 2013 inventory covers container terminals, air-cargo terminals, railway freight stations, bonded areas, truck terminals and wholesale markets. Each point represents the approximate centre of a facility or its site. The documented attributes include name, facility type, classification, address, operator category, development year and a size value. Notes identify the associated port for container terminals and handled cargo for railway freight stations. The inventory supplies physical freight nodes for multimodal logistics simulation. The size field is not, by itself, evidence of a comparable throughput capacity across facility types. The provider supplies GML and Shapefile metadata and download links. Access is free under the National Land Numerical Information terms; the page restricts this edition to non-commercial use. Only the catalogue metadata was reviewed. Dataset files and their current contents were not downloaded. The related parent record is the MLIT National Land Numerical Information catalogue.
